target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Mission-driven local food market in Ashtabula Harbor focused on community, self-reliance, and food security. Features over 50 local vendors, demonstration kitchen, cooking classes, and urban food forest tours. Tech-forward approach to local food distribution with strong community engagement. Curbside pickup with AI confirmations would align perfectly with their innovative, community-focused model.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Locally-owned grocery chain with Jefferson location serving Ashtabula County. Emphasizes community connection with Shurfine private label products, hot foods, and prepared dinners. Already offers DoorDash delivery. A curbside pickup confirmation tool would help them compete with larger chains while maintaining local charm. Multi-store presence suggests potential for broader rollout.
